faq.title: Help Centre
faq.subtitle: Welcome to the Alta Moda webshop Help Centre. On this page you will find all the important information to make your purchase simple, fast and secure — from ordering and payment, through delivery and complaints, to answers to the most frequent questions from professional and retail customers.
faq.notFoundDesc: Our support team is here to help you

orders.q1: How can I order a product?
orders.a1: Choose the product you want, add it to the cart and follow the checkout steps.
orders.q2: Do I have to create an account?
orders.a2: No. You can also shop as a guest. Registered users get order history, faster checkout and access to professional benefits if they qualify for a B2B account.
orders.q3: How do I know my order was received successfully?
orders.a3: After a successful purchase you will receive an e-mail confirmation with all the order details.
orders.q4: Can I change or cancel my order?
orders.a4: If the order has not yet been processed or shipped, contact us as soon as possible. We will do our best to make the change or cancellation.
orders.q5: How can I track my order?
orders.a5: After the parcel is dispatched you will receive tracking information, if the courier service provides it.

payment.q1: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a1:
• Payment cards
• Cash on delivery
• Bank transfer (where available)
payment.a2: Yes. Payment is processed through a secure, certified card-processing system.
payment.q3: Do I get a fiscal receipt?
payment.a3: Yes. Every order comes with a fiscal receipt in accordance with the applicable regulations of the Republic of Serbia.

shipping.q1: Which territories do you deliver to?
shipping.a1: We currently deliver within the territory of the Republic of Serbia.
shipping.a2: Most orders are delivered within 1 to 3 working days from order confirmation.
shipping.a3: The delivery cost is shown at checkout.
shipping.q4: Which courier service do you use?
shipping.a4: Parcels are delivered by an authorised courier service.
shipping.q5: What if I am not at the address at the time of delivery?
shipping.a5: The courier service will attempt redelivery or contact you to arrange it.
shipping.q6: Can I change the delivery address?
shipping.a6: Yes, as long as the order has not yet been handed over to the courier service.
shipping.q7: What should I do when receiving the parcel?
shipping.a7: Before accepting it, check whether the package is visibly damaged. If you notice damage, report it to the courier and contact our team.

returns.a1: Yes, in accordance with the Consumer Protection Act of the Republic of Serbia.
returns.q2: How do I file a complaint?
returns.a2:
Contact us and provide:
• the order number
• a description of the problem
• photos of the product (if needed)
returns.q3: What if I receive the wrong product?
returns.a3: Contact us immediately upon receiving the parcel so we can organise an exchange or find a suitable solution.
returns.q4: What if the product arrives damaged?
returns.a4: Send photos of the product and the packaging immediately upon receiving the parcel.
returns.a5: In the case of an approved return, the funds will be refunded the same way the payment was made, within the legal deadline.

productsFaq.a1: Yes. All products on offer are 100% original and sourced through official supply channels. For selected brands Alta Moda is the official importer and distributor, while other products are sourced and sold in accordance with contractual relationships and the authorisations of their rights holders.
productsFaq.q2: Are the products safe to use?
productsFaq.a2: Yes. All products on offer comply with the applicable regulations of the Republic of Serbia and the European Union.
productsFaq.q3: Do the products have an expiry date?
productsFaq.a3: Yes. The expiry date or period-after-opening is marked on the product packaging.
productsFaq.q4: What does it mean when a product is out of stock?
productsFaq.a4: The product is temporarily sold out. We expect new stock as soon as possible.
productsFaq.q5: Can I reserve a product that is currently unavailable?
productsFaq.a5: Contact us and we will check the possibility of a reservation or notify you when the product is available again.

guarantee.a1:
Buying professional products requires trust, which is why the authenticity of every product is our priority.

All products offered in the Alta Moda webshop are original and sourced exclusively through official supply channels. For selected brands Alta Moda is the official importer and distributor, while other products are sourced and sold in accordance with contractual relationships and the authorisations of their rights holders.

Every product is stored and distributed in line with the manufacturer's recommendations to preserve its quality and safety.

By shopping in the Alta Moda webshop you are buying verified, original products backed by a company with more than 30 years of experience in the professional hair beauty industry.

b2bFaq.q1: How can I become a professional customer?
b2bFaq.a1: Register as a professional user and provide the required verification details.
b2bFaq.q2: Who can use a B2B account?
b2bFaq.a2: Registered hair salons, hairdressers and legal entities that meet the requirements for professional purchasing.
b2bFaq.a3: Verification is usually completed within one working day.
b2bFaq.q4: Are professional prices available to all users?
b2bFaq.a4: No. Professional prices are available exclusively to verified B2B users.
b2bFaq.q5: Why are some prices visible only after signing in?
b2bFaq.a5: Certain professional brands and products are intended exclusively for registered professional users. After successful registration and verification you will be granted access to professional prices and offers, in accordance with the terms of the individual brands.

shopInfo.q1: How to shop in the Alta Moda webshop?
shopInfo.a1:
• Find the product you want via search or categories.
• Add the product to the cart.
• Review the contents of your cart.
• Enter your delivery details.
• Choose a payment method.
• Confirm the order.
• You will receive a purchase confirmation by e-mail.
• After the parcel is dispatched you will be notified about the delivery status or that the order is ready for pickup.
shopInfo.q2: Online or Pro Shop — the choice is yours
shopInfo.a2:
You can shop in whichever way suits you best.

Shopping via the webshop: Simply order the products you want online and we will deliver them to your address or prepare them for personal pickup.

Pickup at the Pro Shop: When ordering via the webshop you can choose the "Pickup at the Pro Shop" option. When your order is ready, we will notify you by e-mail or phone.
shopInfo.a3:
Alta Moda Pro Shop — Mihizova 9, Belgrade.

In our Pro Shop you can:
• buy products from our range
• pick up an online order
• see and compare products before buying
• get expert recommendations from our team
• get to know the professional brands we represent

Whether you shop online or visit us in person, you can count on original products, expert support and professional service.
shopInfo.a4:
• 100% original products
• Official importer and distributor for selected professional brands
• Cooperation with the world's leading manufacturers of professional cosmetics
• More than 30 years of experience in professional hair care
• Secure online shopping
• Fast and reliable delivery
• Expert customer support
• Professional products for hair salons and retail customers
• A carefully selected range of renowned global brands

privacy.a1:
Alta Moda doo is committed to protecting the privacy of all users of the site.

We collect only the data necessary to process orders and communicate with users, such as:
• first and last name
• e-mail address
• phone number
• delivery address
privacy.a2:
The data is used exclusively for:
• fulfilling orders
• communicating with users
• sending newsletter communication (with consent)
privacy.a3: Your data is protected and stored in accordance with the applicable regulations.
privacy.a4: Data is not shared with third parties, except where necessary for delivery (courier services).
privacy.a5:
Users have the right to:
• request access to their data
• request correction or deletion of their data
• withdraw consent to data processing

For any privacy-related questions, users can contact us via the available contact details.

terms.a1:
By using this site you accept these terms of use.

The altamoda.rs site is intended for purchasing products and for information about services and education.
terms.a2: Alta Moda strives to keep all information on the site accurate and up to date, but cannot guarantee that the content is completely error-free.
terms.a3:
All prices are shown in dinars and may be subject to change without prior notice.

Product availability may vary.
terms.a4: Alta Moda is not liable for any technical errors, site outages or other circumstances beyond its control.
terms.a5: We reserve the right to change the terms of use at any time.

education.heroSubtitle: A place where knowledge becomes practice and professional results. Students travel from foundational techniques to confident solo work as hairdressers and stylists.
education.academyP1: ID Hair Academy is the place where knowledge becomes practice and professional results. Through multi-month programmes, students travel from foundational techniques to working independently as hairdressers and stylists.
education.academyP2: Education combines theory, work on training heads and live models, with intensive practice and a constant eye on contemporary global trends and techniques.
education.sectionsTitle: Academy, salon, retail — *and a stage for models*.
education.section1P1: Especially important are *brand seminars* and themed workshops for professionals working with our products, alongside masterclass programmes that follow current industry trends.
education.section1P2: Individual and tailored education is also available — built around the needs of a hairdresser or salon, focused on specific techniques like cutting, colour, and salon performance.
education.section1Bullet1Desc: Sessions with partner brands — products, techniques, salon application.
education.section1Bullet2Desc: Focused modules on specific techniques and technologies.
education.section1Bullet3Desc: Current global trends presented by world-class educators.
education.section1Bullet4Desc: Tailored to a specific hairdresser or salon — cutting, color, process improvement.
education.section2P1: From the heart of Belgrade, for more than 20 years this salon has *set the trends* arriving from the world's most prestigious capitals of fashion and style.
education.section2P2: Clients receive a personalised approach and expert guidance from top hairdressers and stylists, including face-shape, skin tone, style and lifestyle analysis — so every haircut is fully tailored and unique.
education.section2P3: It's a place where contemporary techniques are tested and applied daily under real conditions, in constant exchange between clients and stylists. Clients become a mirror of the salon, and vice versa — through trust, inspiration and the joint creation of a perfect look.
education.section3P1: ID Hair Academy is also an *exclusive retail floor* for professional products.
education.section3P2: Through expert consultation, clients receive a personalised recommendation and the option to buy products tailored to their hair and home-care needs. Salon-grade results become available for everyday care and maintenance of the perfect look.
education.section4Title: Become a *model* at ID Hair Academy
education.section4Kicker: Call for models · cuts, colour, styling
education.section4P1: We invite models for *cuts, colour, styling* and professional treatments within ID Hair Academy education and seminars.
education.section4P2: If you want to be part of our educational process, send photos of your hair, face and full figure to info@id-academy.com — or reach us by phone and social media.
education.contactKicker: Kneza Miloša 23, 11000 Belgrade. Write us, drop by, call — or follow on Instagram.
education.socialDesc: The latest from the academy — education, models, salon transformations.

about.heroLead: Professional hair-care brands and salon equipment, trusted by the industry for more than three decades.
about.introParagraph: Alta Moda doo is a company specialised in the *import and distribution* of professional brands for hair care and salon equipment, with more than three decades of experience in the industry.
about.foundedParagraph: Founded in 1999, the company grew out of long-standing professional work in the hairdressing industry and a vision to give the regional market access to leading global brands and education.
about.distributionParagraph: Today, Alta Moda is a reliable distributor for a wide portfolio of professional brands, and the official importer and distributor for selected brands across Serbia, Montenegro and North Macedonia - with a focus on long-term cooperation, stable distribution and day-to-day partner support.
about.portfolioParagraph: Our portfolio covers professional salon products as well as products designed for home use, sold through both B2B and B2C channels.
about.salonsParagraph: Alta Moda currently works with more than 1,000 active hairdressing salons across the region, alongside the leading online retailers.
about.networkParagraph: Our strength lies not only in the brands we represent, but in the network of people we build long-term relationships with - hairdressers, stylists, educators, make-up artists, event and production teams, and many partners from the fashion and beauty industry.
about.academyAfter: , we run trainings, seminars and masterclass programmes, while our team is actively involved in fashion events, editorials, shoots and fashion productions.
about.systemParagraph: Headquartered in Belgrade, with our own academy, warehouse, network of sales agents and a marketing team, Alta Moda operates as a complete system that connects brands, professionals and the market - offering support in sales, education, promotion and business development.
about.missionParagraph: Responsible and simple — *quality distribution*, professional education and long-term partnerships built on trust and results.
about.ctaDescription: Join the network of more than 1,000 salons already working with Alta Moda. Open an account to access wholesale terms, educational and technical support.

contact.heroDescription: Our team is your partner in the world of the professional hairdressing industry. As the importer and distributor of leading global brands, we connect salons, stylists and educators with the products and solutions that define the modern standard of hair beauty.
contact.newsletterDescription: Be the first to know about new arrivals, professional collections, trends and exclusive brand campaigns. Sign up and receive information about current promotions, special offers and education directly.
contact.heroDescription2: Contact us for information about our range, education, distribution and business partnership — and become part of the network of professionals shaping the industry.
contact.newsletterDescription2: Stay connected with an industry that never stops evolving — and always be a step ahead.

matrix.title: Professional hair products
matrix.p1: Matrix is a professional brand trusted by hairdressers around the world for more than four decades. Created to make professional care accessible to everyone, Matrix offers products suited to different hair types, textures and needs. Whether you are looking for hydration, repair, colour protection, volume or curly-hair care, every collection is developed to deliver reliable results and a simple care routine.
matrix.p2: Combining innovative formulas, modern technologies and the experience of professional hairdressers, Matrix develops shampoos, conditioners, masks, treatments, styling products and professional colour that help hair look healthy, nourished and shiny. Thanks to the wide range, you will easily find products tailored to the exact needs of your hair — whether you are a professional or want salon results at home.
matrix.p3: Matrix is the choice for everyone who wants reliable professional care adapted to the everyday needs of different hair types.

redken.title: Science in the service of healthy, beautiful hair
redken.p1: Redken is one of the best-known professional hair brands, recognised for combining scientific research with salon expertise. For more than 60 years it has been developing innovative formulas that help strengthen, repair and protect hair, delivering visible results tailored to different hair types and needs.
redken.p2: The range includes shampoos, conditioners, masks, treatments, styling products and professional colour developed to answer the challenges of modern hair care. Whether your hair is dry, damaged, colour-treated or prone to breakage, Redken offers professional solutions that help hair become stronger, healthier and better cared for — with results hairdressers around the world trust every day.
redken.p3: Thanks to science-based formulas, Redken delivers targeted results and visibly improves hair quality from the very first uses.

biolage.title: Professional care inspired by nature
biolage.p1: For more than 35 years Biolage has combined inspiration from nature with professional expertise to provide care tailored to different hair needs. Created for those who want healthy, nourished and radiant hair, Biolage blends carefully selected ingredients with modern formulas that deliver effective results and a pleasant feel in everyday use.
biolage.p2: The range includes shampoos, conditioners, masks, treatments and styling products for hydration, repair, colour protection, volume and the care of all hair types. Whether your hair is dry, damaged, colour-treated or fine, Biolage offers professional solutions that help hair stay healthy, soft and full of natural shine.
biolage.p3: Biolage is the ideal choice for those who want professional care inspired by nature, with hair that looks healthy and cared for day after day.

loreal.title: Expertise professionals trust
loreal.p1: For more than a century L'Oréal Professionnel Paris has set the standards in professional hair care and colour. Developed in collaboration with hairdressers around the world, the brand combines innovative technologies, scientific research and decades of experience to offer solutions adapted to the modern needs of salons and clients.
loreal.p2: The range includes professional shampoos, conditioners, masks, treatments, styling products and hair colour for different hair types and needs. Whether you are looking for intensive care, repair, colour protection or long-lasting professional results, L'Oréal Professionnel Paris offers products with reliable performance and care that hairdressers around the world trust every day.
loreal.p3: L'Oréal Professionnel Paris unites professional expertise and innovation to deliver salon results and long-lasting care.

kerastase.title: Luxury care without compromise
kerastase.p1: For more than 60 years Kérastase has been synonymous with luxurious professional hair care. Developed in collaboration with leading scientists and hairdressers, the brand creates personalised solutions that answer the unique needs of every head of hair and every scalp. Combining advanced technologies, carefully selected active ingredients and sophisticated formulas, Kérastase delivers exceptional results you can see and feel.
kerastase.p2: The range includes shampoos, conditioners, masks, serums, oils and treatments for hydration, repair, colour protection, strengthening and revitalisation. Whether you want to solve a specific concern or give your hair the finest care, Kérastase offers care rituals that turn an everyday routine into a unique salon experience.
kerastase.p3: Every care ritual is tailored to the unique needs of your hair, delivering visible results and a feeling of luxury with every use of Kérastase products.

framesi.title: The Italian tradition of professional beauty
framesi.p1: Framesi is one of Italy's leading professional hair brands, with a tradition of more than 80 years. Developed and made in Italy, Framesi combines scientific research, state-of-the-art cosmetic technology and inspiration from contemporary trends to offer complete solutions for professional hairdressers and everyone who wants premium hair care.
framesi.p2: The range includes professional hair colour, shampoos, conditioners, masks, treatments and styling products developed for different hair types and needs. Alongside its renowned colour systems, Framesi is known for high-quality care lines that provide hydration, repair, protection and long-lasting hair beauty. The blend of Italian tradition, innovation and professional expertise makes Framesi a reliable choice for salon and home care.
framesi.p3: Framesi unites professional colour, care and styling in a complete offer for modern hairdressers and everyone who expects premium results.

mariaNila.title: Professional care with a responsible approach to beauty
mariaNila.p1: Maria Nila is a Swedish premium brand that combines professional hair care, sustainability and modern Scandinavian design. Created for hairdressers and everyone who wants premium results, Maria Nila offers products that care for hair without compromise on quality, performance or a responsible relationship with nature.
mariaNila.p2: The range includes thoughtfully designed collections for different hair types and needs — from hydration, repair and colour protection to volume, control of unruly hair and styling. All formulas are 100% vegan and PETA-certified, cruelty-free, with a focus on sustainability in every part of production. Thanks to the combination of professional quality, effective formulations and a responsible approach, Maria Nila is the choice of those who want healthy, well-cared-for hair and products aligned with modern values.
mariaNila.p3: Maria Nila proves that professional quality, sustainability and premium results make a perfect match.

oliviaGarden.title: Professional tools hairdressers trust
oliviaGarden.p1: Olivia Garden is one of the world's best-known brands of professional hairdressing tools, recognised for innovation, premium quality and ergonomic design. For more than 50 years it has been developing brushes, combs, scissors and professional accessories that make hairdressers' work easier and provide precision, comfort and long-lasting performance.
oliviaGarden.p2: The range includes a wide selection of professional blow-dry and styling brushes, detangling brushes, combs, scissors and accessories for everyday salon work as well as home use. Thanks to carefully developed technologies and constant innovation, Olivia Garden tools enable easier styling, gentler detangling and professional results, which is why they are the choice of hairdressers and lovers of quality hair care around the world.
oliviaGarden.p3: Whatever your level of experience, Olivia Garden tools provide precision, comfort and control with every styling.

framar.title: Professional tools for creative hairdressers
framar.p1: Framar is a Canadian professional brand that has become synonymous with innovative hairdressing tools and creative solutions for colouring and styling. Developed by hairdressers for hairdressers, Framar combines functionality, modern design and high quality to make everyday salon work faster, more precise and simpler.
framar.p2: The range includes highlighting foils, colour brushes, bowls, gloves, clips, detangling brushes and a wide selection of professional accessories that meet the needs of modern hairdressers. With innovative products, distinctive design and a commitment to quality, Framar has become one of the favourite brands of professionals around the world who want reliable tools and the freedom to turn their creativity into premium results.
framar.p3: Framar tools are designed to make everyday work more efficient, tidier and more creative.

mizutani.title: Japanese craftsmanship in every cut
mizutani.p1: For more than a century Mizutani Scissors has represented the pinnacle of Japanese craftsmanship in professional hairdressing scissors. Handmade in Japan from the finest materials, Mizutani scissors are known for exceptional precision, perfect ergonomics and long-lasting performance. Every model is developed to give hairdressers maximum control, comfort and confidence with every cut.
mizutani.p2: The range includes professional scissors adapted to different cutting techniques and individual working styles. Thanks to the combination of traditional Japanese craftsmanship, innovative technologies and uncompromising quality, Mizutani is the choice of hairdressers who expect premium performance, longevity and precision without compromise from their tools.
mizutani.p3: Mizutani is the choice of professionals who expect premium precision, control and build quality in every detail.
